reason: Use the involution T(a_1,...,a_n)=(n+1-a_1,...,n+1-a_n). It is a bijection on permutations of {1,...,n}, and it negates every adjacent difference: b_{i+1}-b_i=-(a_{i+1}-a_i). Hence a satisfies s_i(a_{i+1}-a_i)>0 for all i iff T(a) satisfies (-s_i)(b_{i+1}-b_i)>0 for all i. So T gives a bijection between the permutations counted by f(s) and those counted by f(-s), proving f(s)=f(-s).
